frozen_parameters.structural_swing_source: higher_high and lower_low columns from canonical dataset

correction_note: Previous engine produced identical outcomes for S2-S7 because it did not simulate through the price bars after entry — it used a simplified approximation. This engine simulates each trade through the actual OHLC bars after entry. S5/S7 use genuine structural swing levels (higher_high/lower_low from dataset). Where structural levels are unavailable, they are explicitly marked UNAVAILABLE_STRUCTURAL_STOP and not approximated as ATR multiples.
